species.name: Abaddog
species.flavor: Abaddog is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Abbadog
species.flavor: Abbadog is a feral Nexomon with a terrible temper. Please approach with caution in the wild as it may attack even if unprovoked.

species.name: Acca
species.flavor: Acca is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Acegon
species.flavor: A fire-breathing dragon with powerful wings and horns that appear to be the embers of a fire. The flame on its tail changes to an intense blue color when it gets mad.

species.name: Aferaid
species.flavor: They are more scared of tamers than the other way around. But most encounters end up with a fainted tamer.

species.name: Agita
species.flavor: A bioengineered "CHAOS" Nexomon. Along a virtually indestructible body, Agita's sheer strength can generate earthquakes across mountains. The data used to create agita is labeled "MCR-135".

species.name: Algamaid
species.flavor: Algamaid is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Algon
species.flavor: Although this Nexomon lives underwater, it possesses plant characteristics and powers. It occasionally pops out of the water to perform photosynthesis.

species.name: Alpania
species.flavor: Alpania is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Alpoca
species.flavor: Alpoca is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Amphant
species.flavor: Amphant is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Angalo
species.flavor: Angalo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Angelique
species.flavor: Angelique is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Anima
species.flavor: A bioengineered "CHAOS" Nexomon. Anima can telepathically generate tornadoes and storms at far away locations without any physical effort. The data used to create Anima is labeled "MCR-136".

species.name: Antarzen
species.flavor: From the deepest ice lands, this Nexomon emanates a visible mist that freezes everything around it. It can direct such attacks using the fins on its tail and head.

species.name: Antlorm
species.flavor: Its two huge antlers are real storm attractors, no one has ever seen the true potential of Antlorm's lightning storm when imbued with fire.

species.name: Arctivore
species.flavor: Arctivore is a powerful and very loyal Nexomon. It also has an incredible resistance to extreme cold and harsh environments. Watch out for its fangs and sharp claws!

species.name: Arigami
species.flavor: Arigami is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Arispauva
species.flavor: Years of studying human behavior has allowed this Nexomon to take on human-like form. It is often confused with a real human.

species.name: Aristokan
species.flavor: Aristokan is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Arnut
species.flavor: Arnut is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Arqua
species.flavor: The fifth daughter of King Omnicron. This primordial Tyrant of the Seas divided humanity by sinking every ship that dared traverse her domain. Legend has it that she could shapeshift into a human called Merida with questionable volleyball skills.

species.name: Asteor
species.flavor: Asteor is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Auga
species.flavor: Although living primarily underwater, Auga is considered a plant Nexomon. It helps maintain riverways by keeping the water clean.

species.name: Aulion
species.flavor: Aulion is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1 .

species.name: Aulot
species.flavor: Aulot is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1 .

species.name: Azite
species.flavor: Azite is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Aziton
species.flavor: Aziton is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Babicle
species.flavor: This Nexomon forms from the purest water inside ice formations. It likes to pose as a stalactite but are often exposed by its breathing.

species.name: Bactoul
species.flavor: Despite its appearance, it only has one eye in its body. Its other eye-like parts are psychic sensors to detect different wave types, making it virtually impossible to ambush.

species.name: Ballery
species.flavor: Ballery is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Baloompa
species.flavor: A free soul wandering among the clouds. It likes to be left alone with its freedom, especially when it has a chance to land and get some rest.

species.name: Barboraco
species.flavor: A strong, bulky Nexomon with blazing skills. It trains every day to keep its body fat to a minimum.

species.name: Barkrunch
species.flavor: Barkrunch is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Barky
species.flavor: Barky is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Barver
species.flavor: Barver is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Basil
species.flavor: This dragon Nexomon is very friendly and playful. Although it cannot fly very high, it lifts off from the ground and glides when happy.

species.name: Basten
species.flavor: Basten is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bedam
species.flavor: Bedam is a very popular Nexomon. It is always carrying a huge log to use as a floating device and also as a weapon. Researches indicate that once a young Bedam finds a good log, it stays with it for the rest of its life.

species.name: Behilda
species.flavor: A ghost Nexomon that can be found wandering the darkness. It likes to detach its head to scare off opponents.

species.name: Berawn
species.flavor: Berawn is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bevy
species.flavor: Bevy is a -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bilabeka
species.flavor: Bilabeka is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bira
species.flavor: Its sharp reflexes - and sharper nails - make it a great hunter and tracker.

species.name: Biralo
species.flavor: Even without reaching its full potential, this Nexomon can outmatch most of its competitors in terms of speed and agility.

species.name: Bisina
species.flavor: Swift, agile, and smart. This Nexomon makes lightning-fast decisious faster than any other Nexomon. Experienced tamers know its true potential.

species.name: Blazetilia
species.flavor: A fire Nexomon with twin fire blades in its arms. Its speed and powerful whipping tail should be watched.

species.name: Blimpapa
species.flavor: Its more social Nexomon than Baloompa, but generally thinks only of travel and adventure.

species.name: Blit
species.flavor: A fire Nexomon who loves night festivals. Contact with tamers increases its power and brightness.

species.name: Blizbrow
species.flavor: Blizbrow is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Blizloo
species.flavor: Blizloo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Blizo
species.flavor: Blizo is a -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Blizstrong
species.flavor: Blizstrong can usually be found in high-altitude locations, with only a few people claiming to have seen it. Giant footprints on hard-to-reach places raise the question of where it lives.

species.name: Blizzarm
species.flavor: This ice dragon leaves a sub-zero trail that allows it to move swiftly wherever it goes.

species.name: Blizzaur
species.flavor: A huge stomping ice dragon with a prehistoric bad mood. Its frozen heart makes it difficult to tame.

species.name: Bloomriol
species.flavor: Its wide variety of skills make it perfect for almost any type of tamer. It can use any part of its body as a diversion or to deliver powerful attacks.

species.name: Bloopish
species.flavor: This colorful water Nexomon moves in large groups. Its shiny scales produce an amazing light effect underwater.

species.name: Blublub
species.flavor: A bubbly Nexomon containing a mysterious foam core. Its very curious but shy at the same time.

species.name: Blurk
species.flavor: Blurk is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bogarp
species.flavor: Bogarp is an ancient Nexomon, and experts say that they may live for centuries given the right circumstances. Some Nexomon seeks Bogarps for their knowledge.

species.name: Boilgog
species.flavor: This Nexomon's body is made from melting and boiling materials. Its movements are slow, scorching everything at its path. Although it can reshape most of its body, it does have four legs.

species.name: Boltusk
species.flavor: Boltusk is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bolzen
species.flavor: A rare sight indeed, Bolzen's general location is a mystery to most and yet, he always conveniently appears to deal the final blow when another Tyrant is weakened. The Tyrant of Thunder seems capable of traveling throughout the world in an instant, making it a difficult target for the Guild's tamers.

species.name: Bombargrof
species.flavor: Bombargrofs is an alert and agile Nexomon, with the ability to learn and use any kind of fire technique.

species.name: Bomblasta
species.flavor: It can jump, roll, and turn itself into a fire ball which is very difficult to avoid.

species.name: Bomriol
species.flavor: This Nexomon uses its fluffy chest for defense while landing attacks with its heavy feet. Its twin leaf wings distract its opponents while the bloom on its back allows for greater attacks.

species.name: Boscage
species.flavor: One would expect to find this greater drake in the woods, but nobody has been able to pinpoint his home. As a matter of fact, there is no documentation of Boscage ever fighting a Tyrant at all, which baffles dragon enthusiasts.

species.name: Bosdour
species.flavor: Bosdour is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bouldcran
species.flavor: It can control rock and crystal with the stone in its heads and can smash minerals to dust with its tail too.

species.name: Bouldion
species.flavor: Its tiny legs aren't built for running, so it rolls around to move. The little mace on the end of its tail is said to be as tough as diamond.

species.name: Bovicue
species.flavor: Hamoo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bowish
species.flavor: Bowish is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Boxrock
species.flavor: Boxrock is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bozofin
species.flavor: Bozofin is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Braccus
species.flavor: The strongest of the Abyssal Tyrants. Braccus emerged in the desert, and marched towards dozens of cities leaving only ruin. People were convinced that he’d become the new King of Monsters, until Grandmaster Xanders finally put an end to him.

species.name: Branipus
species.flavor: From the depths of the ocean comes this squishy friend. Its brain power allows him to levitate for some time.

species.name: Brauncer
species.flavor: Loyal and super strong, its fighting spirit requires a disciplined and skillful tamer.

species.name: Breeshy
species.flavor: Breeshy is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Briar
species.flavor: This small seed-like Nexomon makes a curious noise like those of a trumpet. The bulb on its back widens as if it will bloom at any moment.

species.name: Broduo
species.flavor: Broduo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Broshield
species.flavor: Broshield is a defensive Nexomon, and not many attacks can pierce through its defenses. The very few attacks that do are met with a thick skin making its defense almost flawless.

species.name: Browi
species.flavor: Browi is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Brumenie
species.flavor: It appears in very foggy locations, the wisps at its hands granting the power to materialize objects or conjure illusions.

species.name: Brumtler
species.flavor: It can materialize or dematerialize at will and has at its disposal powerful ghostly skills.

species.name: Bulbrit
species.flavor: It uses its two cable-like arms to gather electric particles from the air, allowing it to recharge. It enjoys swinging its arms while doing it.

species.name: Bulie
species.flavor: Bulie is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bulken
species.flavor: Bulken is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bullogan
species.flavor: A powerful wrestler with a wide variety of moves, it likes to grab, toss, submit, and smash its opponents while showing off.

species.name: Bunrock
species.flavor: Bunrock is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Bushnome
species.flavor: A wise and ancient Nexomon that lives in tall grass and near rivers. It is rumored to transform into trees in order to go unnoticed.

species.name: Byeol
species.flavor: This utterly enigmatic Tyrant is... weird? Bizarre? This thing is always staring and smiling. The person writing this entry feels uncomfortable describing Byeol so let's leave it at that.

species.name: Cacteone
species.flavor: Cacteone is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cactino
species.flavor: Cactino is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cadeto
species.flavor: It oversees training the youngest Croos and whoever else wants to join the flock.

species.name: Caelesa
species.flavor: Caelesa was an Abyssal Tyrant that raced across the continent, making it exceptionally difficult to hunt down. Whether it was chasing a target or running from something, the Guild could never find out.

species.name: Calfter
species.flavor: A strong willed Nexomon that learns very fast, especially new attack techniques. It gets easily distracted, but always strives to become powerful.

species.name: Calplex
species.flavor: Its skull is as strong as those of mineral Nexomon and can break rocks with its headbutt.

species.name: Camoleon
species.flavor: Camoleon is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Candly
species.flavor: Its agility and acrobatics make it a formidable hunter. When tamed, its possibilities are limited purely by the tamer's skills.

species.name: Candrama
species.flavor: Candrama is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Caninui
species.flavor: It excels at telekinetic powers and with only a little concentration can move massive objects at great speeds over vast distances.

species.name: Carcaros
species.flavor: Faster and stronger than Muu, its red eye is perfect for seeing in the dark. It leaves a crimson trail when using its spectral powers.

species.name: Carnagrius
species.flavor: Carnagrius are not particularly fond of humans. A long time ago, humans destroyed their natural habitat making them very cautious of tamers. Although it is tough to earn a Carnagrius trust, once a tamer achieves this feat, they become inseperable.

species.name: Cavel
species.flavor: Cavel is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Centeror
species.flavor: A real nightmare. Master of the night, always haunting tamers and other Nexomon.

species.name: Cerebrius
species.flavor: Tentacles play a major defense role on a Cerebrius, allowing it to detect enemies all around him.

species.name: Chaparral
species.flavor: After the seed on its body germinates, its body develops legs, a vine tail, and a flower crest.

species.name: Charoon
species.flavor: Charoon is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cheekmunch
species.flavor: Cheekmunch is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cheekmunk
species.flavor: Cheekmunk is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Chibbit
species.flavor: Some say Chibbits are a failed experiment because they live near to scientific facilities, but recent investigations have proven that they have a natural origin.

species.name: Chicolo
species.flavor: Chicolo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Chirpoint
species.flavor: Chirpoint is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Chirrent
species.flavor: This Nexomon is fast and very competitive. When it reaches top speed, it leaves a trail of static that can paralyze whoever touches it.

species.name: Chowser
species.flavor: It enjoys cooking using only natural ingredients. Don't think it will be willing to share any of its food!

species.name: Clobolt
species.flavor: Clobolt is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cloddy
species.flavor: A small cuddly Nexomon enveloped in fluffy fur that helps it keep balance on its tiny legs.

species.name: Clonkey
species.flavor: Clonkey is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Clunder
species.flavor: Clunder is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Columbra
species.flavor: Columbras are dangerous Nexomon as opponents, but many would find it surprising how great companions they are. They particularly enjoy wrapping around their tamers to keep them warm during wintertime.

species.name: Coral
species.flavor: This free spirit of the sea has a natural power that restores entire eco systems. It moves in groups, and wherever it goes, coral reefs become full of color.

species.name: Cordyant
species.flavor: Cordyant is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Corozard
species.flavor: Corozard is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cotondee
species.flavor: Cotondee is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Couplet
species.flavor: The amazing plant duo. They have seperate bodies but a synergy without match that allows them to fight as a single Nexomon.

species.name: Cragodillo
species.flavor: Cragodillo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Cranillow
species.flavor: Wherever someone sees this Nexomon, a sad whistling sound can be heard. Its inexpressive face gives it an even more frightening visage.

species.name: Cranoad
species.flavor: Its kicking power is so great that it uses it to bounce on surroundings to confuse its opponent before landing a final disabling blow.

species.name: Cromeon
species.flavor: It handles one type of current on each arm. Its entire body is a big electricity store that can be channeled through one or both limbs.

species.name: Croncho
species.flavor: A black-gloved thief that uses stealth while underwater. Its tail is so powerful that it can cut a tree in half.

species.name: Cronic
species.flavor: Cronic is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Croo
species.flavor: Its flocks can be found on almost every coast. Sailors use Croo flocks to seek land.

species.name: Cruff
species.flavor: A naughty water Nexomon, skillful at stealing items from shores. After being tamed it becomes very loyal and noble.

species.name: Cryzzard
species.flavor: Nicknamed the "sentry of winter", this small Nexomon behaves like a soldier and lives mainly in cold landscapes.

species.name: Cubdy
species.flavor: This Nexomon is usually very distracted making soft noises and mumbling while absorbed in its thoughts. However, it is among the most intelligent of Nexomon.

species.name: Cuisizle
species.flavor: A master of spicy high cuisine. Its opponents always get over-cooked.

species.name: Dalsae
species.flavor: Its color patterns have inspired famous paintings. It's also known for its swiftness, explosiveness, and majestic power.

species.name: Dandelloon
species.flavor: Dandelloon is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Dandemill
species.flavor: Dandemill is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Darine
species.flavor: One of Ziegler's creations, Darine is a loyal servant of the Netherworld King. She serves as one of the many wardens in the Afterlife. Not much else is known about her.

species.name: Deebuz
species.flavor: It excels at combining attacks, the twin manes made of fire emanating from its shoulders providing natural defense.

species.name: Deember
species.flavor: This Nexomon can control fire. It small antlers collect static energy from the air, while its hooves collect heat from the soil.

species.name: Dethwurm
species.flavor: Dethwurm is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Devoul
species.flavor: Lacking expression, this Nexomon is considered a rare apparition who wanders aimlessly. There is a glimpse of sadness in its masks.

species.name: Deyam
species.flavor: If you spot a Deyam in the wild, it's usually as bad as a nightmare you cannot wake up from.

species.name: Deyama
species.flavor: Its deep-red eyes look like portals to another world. Don't stare for too long or you'll be in trouble.

species.name: Dichala
species.flavor: A fierce praire hunters, it excels at lurking and then swiftly attacking. Its sense of smell and hearing is astounding.

species.name: Digga
species.flavor: Digga is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Dinja
species.flavor: It has short legs, adorable big ears, and a huge fluffy tail. Since it isn't a good runner, it prefers to hop.

species.name: Divette
species.flavor: Its psychic skills enhance its sound and vibration-based attacks. Its floating rings act as giant speakers which create illusion with soundwaves.

species.name: Domigator
species.flavor: A master of underwater stealth. In rivers, lakes, coasts, during heavy rain or fog, it blends in with its surroundings perfectly, waiting to launch its powerful bite.

species.name: Draclone
species.flavor: Draclone is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Dracly
species.flavor: An acrobatic flying Nexomon with powerful wings. Its wind moves are empowered at nighttime.

species.name: Dracon
species.flavor: The greater drake of blaze dwells around the desert, near the entrance to New Ignitia. On extremely rare occasions he travels underground to rest.

species.name: Drakuza
species.flavor: Drakuza is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Draniphant
species.flavor: Draniphants are all about attention, they shoot water from their trunk to catch everybody’s attention.

species.name: Drare
species.flavor: The smallest offspring of the ancient red dragon, its eyes shine like fire. Don't make jokes about its short arms or you might end up getting roasted.

species.name: Drash
species.flavor: Drash is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Dratter
species.flavor: A nimble Nexomon that uses its long fluffy tails to soar in the air unexpectedly fast. It possesses great physical strength.

species.name: Dreaver
species.flavor: Dreavers have become very popular nowadays as their psychic powers seem to be very efficient for preventing bad dreams.

species.name: Dreddiful
species.flavor: An advanced spectral manifestation. No one has ever withstood the glare of the red eyes on its hands. A very cold wind blows before it appears during very dark nights.

species.name: Dredmore
species.flavor: While this Nexomon has a very long history, its origins are still unknown. Maybe for the best...

species.name: Dredrone
species.flavor: There are legends connecting Dredrone to inter-dimensional portals. Its inner strings produce a soft sound with lullaby-like effects.

species.name: Driftle
species.flavor: Driftle is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Dromeruf
species.flavor: Dromeruf is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Duh
species.flavor: A special Nexomon from the far east. Information about it is sparse at best.

species.name: Duktar
species.flavor: A floating apparition that enjoys chasing people in lonely places or haunted mountain forests.

species.name: Dunefin
species.flavor: Dunefin is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Durtacles
species.flavor: It rolls dirt balls containing various minerals which serve as a temporary shelter.

species.name: Durtworm
species.flavor: Durtworm is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Eele
species.flavor: Eele is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Eelowatt
species.flavor: Eelowatt is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Emotel
species.flavor: Emotel is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Emperabee
species.flavor: Emperabee is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Enercer
species.flavor: It flies primarily during the rainy season. Dubbed "Bringer of the Storm" because thunder is sure to follow just after its appearance.

species.name: Enerfox
species.flavor: Enerfox is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1 .

species.name: Enermine
species.flavor: Enermine is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Eqo
species.flavor: It prefers dark places where light cannot affect its eyes. Virtually blind, it navigates using supersonic squeaks.

species.name: Eqoloptera
species.flavor: Its great hearing and infra-red vision allow it to attack swiftly. It stands on its two feet to channel electricity.

species.name: Eurus
species.flavor: A puzzling Tyrant indeed. Although Eurus desires to become the next King of Monsters, he doesn't try at all. Despite being undoubtedly powerful, Eurus spends every day relaxing in the Drake Isles and doesn't even mind living amongst humans. To make the situation even more baffling, dragons don't bother attacking him. How is this all possible?

species.name: Excavat
species.flavor: Excavat is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Excravator
species.flavor: Even though it possesses powerful electric attacks, its weapon of choice is an enormous pincer.

species.name: Expunk
species.flavor: Expunk is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fainglori
species.flavor: Its dance is something to be admired. Too bad it also serves as a warning to its opponents of an imminent attack.

species.name: Fandiose
species.flavor: Fandiose are considerable faster than the average Nexomon, but its greatest perk is the long distances it can travel without getting tired.

species.name: Fane
species.flavor: A mysterious Nexomon said to appear only to those who have beaten countless enemies and proven their worth.

species.name: Fanfrou
species.flavor: Fanfrou is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fanling
species.flavor: This Nexomon is fast and elusive which makes it difficult to catch. Its hopping movement generates small gusts of wind.

species.name: Faucefant
species.flavor: Faucefant has a playful personality. It enjoys rolling over and showering their friends by surprise while hiding in the grass.

species.name: Favolia
species.flavor: Favolia is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Felarnia
species.flavor: This Nexomon is an extremely capable hunter and a masters of the wind, using it as a platform to double jump and reach airborne enemies.

species.name: Felclaw
species.flavor: A black belt master of the martial arts. Its kicks are only surpassed by its steel-claw style. It can also land devastating kicks covered in flames.

species.name: Feliblanqo
species.flavor: It has a mixture of different emotions, which are reflected in its erratic fighting style. Only a true master tamer can take advantage of its potential.

species.name: Felicient
species.flavor: Felicient is a highly agile Nexomon. It wears strange-looking ornaments around its neck, leading to the idea that they can guide tamers to unique ancient treasures.

species.name: Felynth
species.flavor: Felynth is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1 .

species.name: Ferodile
species.flavor: Ferodile likes to lurk in the wild and surprise unsuspecting tamers from behind. It usually lays on its belly, but in battle, it stands up to intimidate the opponent, this combined with powerful jaws makes most Nexomon avoid them at all times.

species.name: Ferosera
species.flavor: Ferosera is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fethra
species.flavor: Fethra is a -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fetidoom
species.flavor: Fetidoom is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Firius
species.flavor: Firius is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fistuff
species.flavor: This Nexomon combines the soft grace of martial arts with some good old-school pummeling. It can move from one style to another without problem and can also use its tail to attack.

species.name: Flaminglo
species.flavor: Flaminglo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Flandle
species.flavor: Flandle is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Flaringo
species.flavor: Flaringo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fleecius
species.flavor: Fleecius is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Flexel
species.flavor: Flexel is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Flizard
species.flavor: Flizards are easier to spot on hot days when they are more active. However, when they gather enough heat, some might shine with a bright red glow at night.

species.name: Floatle
species.flavor: Floatle is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Florantis
species.flavor: Florantis is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Florauga
species.flavor: It uses its four sensors to search for food and stay aware of enemies. The extension at the tip of its leaf is used to listen to its surroundings.

species.name: Floreina
species.flavor: Many Nexomon are inclined to serve and obey Floreina. Is it because of its fabulous smell? Or perhaps something more... magical?

species.name: Floreus
species.flavor: Floreus is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Florozard
species.flavor: Its almost impossible to spot this Nexomon unless its willing to get close to you. It has perfect camouflage techinques, moving across leaves and branches in the blink of an eye.

species.name: Flotter
species.flavor: An attentive and brave Nexomon. Its body is so lightweight that it moves across the air like a feather.

species.name: Flousper
species.flavor: Flousper is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fluzard
species.flavor: Fluzard is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Flybuster
species.flavor: Flybuster is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Folicurse
species.flavor: It prefers to be left alone. Should you enter a house haunted by a Folicurse, prepare to experience paranormal activity.

species.name: Fona
species.flavor: The third son of King Omnicron, this primordial Tyrant once engulfed our world in a century of black skies and fire. According to legend, Fona could take the guise of a human being named Fenrir.

species.name: Foreer
species.flavor: A majestic Nexomon of the forest. It stores solar energy in its bloom crest and tail. The tail also serves as a weapon during battle.

species.name: Fortank
species.flavor: The amount of vegetation around its tower and legs shows just how slow this Nexomon is. It compensates its slow speed with an unbreakable defense and resistance to attack.

species.name: Fortle
species.flavor: Fortles are slow but a tough little Nexomon. They are thrilled to play with others by carrying them on their shells. This characteristic makes them very popular with kids.

species.name: Fortoise
species.flavor: Their defense allows them to resist almost any attack while securing certain victory. They are like a walking fortress and hence the name.

species.name: Fowling
species.flavor: Fowling is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Foxdra
species.flavor: It obtains energy from mystical sources. The shards on its back produce a chiming sound and its power doubles if it can eat its favorite meal.

species.name: Francelstud
species.flavor: Francelstud is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Frictingle
species.flavor: It channels static energy through its tail then releases massive amounts of energy in the form of wild electric charges.

species.name: Frilia
species.flavor: Frilia is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Frogick
species.flavor: This Nexomon packs a powerful kick and can blow any opponent away.

species.name: Frogue
species.flavor: Frogue is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Frominence
species.flavor: Frominence, is a direct evolution from the ancient species of Fropip. Tamers are puzzled by its change in personality. Once a shy Nexomon known as Fropip, is now known to be a strong leader whose only concern is the welfare of other Nexomon.

species.name: Fropip
species.flavor: Fropip is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Froppe
species.flavor: Froppe is a flamboyant Nexomon that is both stylish and a powerful companion. Tamers love to capture Froppe but quickly regret it due to the high maintenance they require.

species.name: Frulf
species.flavor: Frulf is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Fulmina
species.flavor: A bioengineered "CHAOS" Nexomon. Fulmina's skin can ignite anything it touches, easily destroying whatever landscape it ventures into. The data used to create Fulmina is labeled "MCR-137".

species.name: Fumous
species.flavor: Fumous is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Furpy
species.flavor: Furpy is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Furrygon
species.flavor: Its tail is so long that it can be seen holding part of it while standing. Despite being so fluffy, it uses its tail as a weapon in battle. Try not to get hit!

species.name: Fuzztino
species.flavor: Fuzztino is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Galvaria
species.flavor: Galvaria is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Gekoko
species.flavor: A curious Nexomon with the ability to walk on any surface with its sticky feet. It challenges itself to stay hidden from others for long periods of time.

species.name: Gemaxar
species.flavor: Gemaxars are mineral Nexomon with total control of the magnetic fields. The crystal shards around them are like autonomous independent limbs for defense.

species.name: Gemeen
species.flavor: Gemeen not only looks like royalty but also acts like it. Be prepared to impress one if you want to befriend a Gemeen. Precious minerals usually do the trick but don't even think to show up without a present.

species.name: Gemir
species.flavor: Gemir is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Gemock
species.flavor: Gemocks use the power of minerals to empower their jeweled limbs and generate their levitation powers.

species.name: Gervore
species.flavor: Gervore is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ghouze
species.flavor: This creepy Nexomon is less dangerous than it appears. Don't let it fool you though! It tends to lose people in the wild by either scaring them or misguiding them.

species.name: Giddiyelp
species.flavor: This Nexomon can be bothersome when it groups with others, as they tend to attack tamers for no reason.

species.name: Glamond
species.flavor: This voracious greater drake is busy all day and night waging war against the countless Tyrants who roam the Frozen Tundra for unknown reasons. Glamond can be found sleeping in icy caves, where it has befriended some of the local Nexomite miners.

species.name: Glamoory
species.flavor: Beauty and power can be found on its silky fins. Fishermen are extra careful when it appears as they might end up facing the Queen of the Sea.

species.name: Glidlee
species.flavor: Soaring like a leaf in the wind, it doesn't worry about speed or agility. It almost seems like it has a sixth sense that allows it to avoid opponents just by letting itself go with the wind.

species.name: Glimoory
species.flavor: Style and swiftness. Victory with glamour. The appeal of this Nexomon is equivalent to its skill in battle.

species.name: Globlob
species.flavor: A Nexomon with a bubbly core. Its body is a perfect mix of active chemicals that produces a nice smell.

species.name: Glontern
species.flavor: It loves festivals and celebrations. It tends to live near towns and often mingles with the townspeople at night.

species.name: Glunch
species.flavor: It specializes in using sugar-powered psychic energy. No one dares wonder what would happen if it used it all at once.

species.name: Gnaligator
species.flavor: Gnaligator is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Gnob
species.flavor: Gnob is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Goateeze
species.flavor: An outwardly calm Nexomon. When it wants to play, it becomes very energetic and jumps around like an excitable human child.

species.name: Goatlanche
species.flavor: It makes a low-pitched sound that can summon snow avalanches anywhere, at any time. It becomes super energetic when in a playful mood.

species.name: Goblat
species.flavor: This Nexomon is all about vibrations, hearing and emitting supersonic waves, which it converts into electricity to be stored in its spiky fur.

species.name: Golematon
species.flavor: Golematon is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Gomarm
species.flavor: "Be like rubber" its master said, and so it trains tirelessly to attain, as instructed, the state of mind and elastic force.

species.name: Gorgonita
species.flavor: Gorgonita is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Graciful
species.flavor: It's known to use beautiful flowers and its elegance as a tactic during battle.

species.name: Gradow
species.flavor: A spectral Nexomon full of mysteries, enclosed in an ancient structure. Allegedly created by an obscure curse. Its motivation and purpose are yet to be discovered.

species.name: Graloon
species.flavor: Perhaps the most efficient of the greater drakes. When a Tyrant brings chaos somewhere in the Outlands, Graloon is often seen diving out of the skies like a meteorite. Tyrants have come to acknowledge its strength and actively avoid any confrontation.

species.name: Grath
species.flavor: While its slow and deep breaths give off a calm appearance, its brute force is beyond imagination. It trains with whatever it finds.

species.name: Gravello
species.flavor: Its harder shell and sharp spikes don't hinder its movement. It can rapidly dig holes into the ground.

species.name: Grebal
species.flavor: It carries a pearl wherever it goes as both a memento of its childhood and to serve as a booster for its powers. This elusive Nexomon can use the shell in its head for defense.

species.name: Greben
species.flavor: Dubbed the "saints of the ocean", it makes coral and algae grow wherever it goes. Most of its skills are summoned after a traditional dance with its fan-like tail.

species.name: Griff
species.flavor: Double the curiosity and bravery of other felines. This Nexomon has the courage of a true king.

species.name: Griffgar
species.flavor: Griffgar manes might vary in size depending on their age. They like to get into practice fights to hone their skills, so one day they can lead the pack.

species.name: Grimmon
species.flavor: Grimmon is the manifestation of fear. Only brave and expert tamers should approach it, and then with great caution.

species.name: Gritch
species.flavor: Gritch is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Grumug
species.flavor: Grumug is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Grunda
species.flavor: King Omnicron’s first-born child. Grunda was a titan of unparalleled strength whose very mood determined the fate of entire countries. His final resting place is somewhere in the desert but, even millennia later, tamers still fear to disturb him.

species.name: Grush
species.flavor: Grush is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Guazharm
species.flavor: Master of elasticity, its fighting style is based around stretching its limbs to amass and release power swiftly.

species.name: Gurgita
species.flavor: A bioengineered "CHAOS" Nexomon. Gurgita seems capable of controlling tidal waves and cause floods over remarkable distances. The data used to create Gurgita is labeled "MCR-138".

species.name: Hainok
species.flavor: It has a strange property that allows it to walk on water without sinking. It can reach ridiculous speeds when flying.

species.name: Hamoo
species.flavor: Hamoo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Harectic
species.flavor: It uses its entire body and tail as a giant whip. It can also use its serpentine moves combined with the spikes around its body to attach or detach from any surface.

species.name: Heddeca
species.flavor: Its always smiling regardless of the situation. Having one of its arms occupied holding its head, it uses the remaining limbs to generate powerful ghost attacks.

species.name: Heifry
species.flavor: Heifry is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Helipa
species.flavor: When evolved, Heliwurm encloses in a cocoon and goes airborne.

species.name: Heliventus
species.flavor: Heliventus keep their hard Helipa shell as a helmet, for they are natural air aces. Combined with their superior wind power, Heliventus know no fear.

species.name: Heliwurm
species.flavor: Heliwurms can manipulate wind by using their windmill shaped antenna. Do not be fooled by its fluffy look, they can summon powerful gusts of wind.

species.name: Helovolk
species.flavor: An Abyssal Tyrant that dwelled underground restlessly digging seemingly random tunnels, eluding the Guild’s attention for many decades.

species.name: Hexia
species.flavor: The most vicious of Ziegler's followers. Hexia is an excellent hunter, tasked with tracking down those who dare escape from the depths of the Netherworld.

species.name: Hexopus
species.flavor: Hexopus is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Hinazuru
species.flavor: Pride is the main trait of this Nexomon. You don't want to make it angry.

species.name: Hissa
species.flavor: Hissa is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Hoardent
species.flavor: Hoardent is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Hobyn
species.flavor: Hobyn is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Hoglet
species.flavor: Hoglet is more agile than it looks. It tends to hop back and forth while in battle to keep its stamina and fire from fading.

species.name: Hohopi
species.flavor: A friendly and warm Nexomon, it is loyal and very protective of those it loves.

species.name: Hollowretch
species.flavor: Hollowretch is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Holoch
species.flavor: Its nest is always covered in shiny cocoons waiting to hatch into numerous Worbs.

species.name: Honbuzz
species.flavor: Honbuzz is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Hoppeti
species.flavor: Hoppeti is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Horget
species.flavor: A loyal, playful Nexomon with those it has formed a bond with, and a wild beast against those it has not.

species.name: Hurristag
species.flavor: Hurristag is a Nexomon known for its speed and reaction time. This Nexomon is notorious for being extremely hard to catch because of its quick reflexes and speed, both of which can be extremely useful in battle.

species.name: Hydrax
species.flavor: Hydrax is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Hydrip
species.flavor: This Nexomon excels at putting out fires.

species.name: Hydrose
species.flavor: When fully grown, it searches for large bodies of water like lakes. There are legends about a giant Hydrose attacking ships in the past, but there is no evidence to support these claims.

species.name: Hyphoon
species.flavor: The very few that have been tamed were found in the eye of hurricanes. For some reason, it is attracted to them.

species.name: Idolette
species.flavor: Idolette is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Igneamp
species.flavor: Igneamp is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ignia
species.flavor: Ignia is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ignigon
species.flavor: Its horns and chest are made of fire crystal, the archeological proof that it is descendant of a legendary fire dragon. It can't fly properly but are nevertheless proud of its wings.

species.name: Imburion
species.flavor: It can generate fire from its horns and wrap itself in flames when facing a tough opponent.

species.name: Imbuzi
species.flavor: A daredevil Nexomon that jumps from rock to rock on mountainsides. Its horns generate fire to keep it warm.

species.name: Immortis
species.flavor: An undead giant with extreme strength and supernatural powers. Even its tamer gets the shivers when summoning it into battle.

species.name: Inominox
species.flavor: An elusive and calculating Abyssal Tyrant. Inominox outlived generations of tamers as he carefully picked his fights by never engaging strong opponents.

species.name: Jagstrich
species.flavor: Jagstrich is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Jampa
species.flavor: Jampa is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Jeeta
species.flavor: Jeeta is the fastest Nexomon to date. Not a single Nexomon comes even close to matching its full speed. Jeeta uses its electrified nervous system to jumpstart its muscles like no other Nexomon. You won't even see it coming.

species.name: Jeliflo
species.flavor: Although it is seen as being rather intelligent, it cares very little for anything else other than dancing in the water and going with the flow.

species.name: Jeliflux
species.flavor: This Nexomon can grow up to seven feet. It's best not to underestimate it during battle!

species.name: Jellien
species.flavor: Jellien is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Jellufo
species.flavor: Jellufo is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Jeloon
species.flavor: A squishy, translucid inhabitant of deep waters. Its carefree personality is contagious.

species.name: Kamelevo
species.flavor: A sneaky lightning fast Nexomon with the ability to blend into any environment. It sends electrical charges to its skin cells creating a chemical reaction that changes its color.

species.name: Kawsnow
species.flavor: A flexible and sneaky Nexomon that resides in the coldest places, it detects movement and temperature using its tail and ear like fins.

species.name: Keromb
species.flavor: Most people are aware of its anger management issues. It can be witnessed exploding just to reset the immense amount of heat in its body.

species.name: Kerosion
species.flavor: More volatile and angrier than most Nexomon, it translates this to power, but only on command for the most seasoned tamers.

species.name: Kiklick
species.flavor: Kiklick is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Kindala
species.flavor: Kindala is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Kindeor
species.flavor: Kindeor is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Kitsunox
species.flavor: Vulazy is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Kolphur
species.flavor: This scorching pebble has a magma core which also forms its one eye. When chasing them, be careful not to trip on their trail or your shoes might melt.

species.name: Krainnull
species.flavor: This greater drake befriended the ghosts of the Immortal Citadel. It's been theorized that he's under a similar curse as them and, as such, Tyrants don't even bother fighting Krainnull, for it would be a pointless encounter.

species.name: Kroma
species.flavor: The most recent Abyssal Tyrant. Kroma sought to crush the Immortal Citadel a few years ago, but failed upon clashing with Grandmaster Deena. Kroma is capable of influencing and commanding spirits.

species.name: Kromatice
species.flavor: Kromatice is a beautiful wind Nexomon and spends most of the time soaring through the skies showing off its beautiful colors. These colors are not just for showoff but also as a distraction for tamers and other Nexomon alike.

species.name: Kromicide
species.flavor: It's always in a bad mood. It doesn't hide away like other ghost Nexomon and instead wants to be seen to give people goosebumps.

species.name: Krowr
species.flavor: A behemoth serving on the frontlines of Ziegler's dark army. With his sheer strength, Krowr can relentlessly siege just about any kind of enemy stronghold.

species.name: Kumacho
species.flavor: Kumacho is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Kyte
species.flavor: Kyte is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Lagorove
species.flavor: Lagorove is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Lamparos
species.flavor: A powerful fire container with a strong sense of honor. It likes to guide lost travelers to the nearest inn.

species.name: Lantora
species.flavor: Lantora is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Larkito
species.flavor: Larkitos live fast and curious, with very short periods of activity followed by short naps. They are easily blown away when flying at high altitude.

species.name: Lavamp
species.flavor: Lavamp is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Leafegg
species.flavor: Leafegg is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Leechy
species.flavor: This cute little Nexomon has a lot of tricks under its wings... and a furry tail.

species.name: Lioness
species.flavor: Lioness has a majestic figure, plus its great strength makes them a foe to be respected. Their roar can be heard up to a distance of 5 miles.

species.name: Lovidovi
species.flavor: Lovidovi is the literal example of duality, its two poles complement each other to keep its powerful psychic energy in check. It loves all beings regardless of what they are.

species.name: Lovinu
species.flavor: Lovinu is a real mystery, all that is known about it is that it has two different psychic energy charges at each side of its body, as if it were different poles.

species.name: Luberg
species.flavor: Luberg is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Luhava
species.flavor: It's said that this ancient Nexomon guided brave adventurers across the continent to fulfill their heroic roles, only to disappear shortly after.

species.name: Lukuma
species.flavor: When a Cubdy evolves into Lukuma it becomes very grumpy and aggressive, as well as territorial. Yet, it tends to space out from time to time.

species.name: Lumbi
species.flavor: Lumbi has a very short temper and is known as a skilled fighter.

species.name: Lume
species.flavor: Not a recommended partner for those who love to hug their Nexomon. Lume's head, paws and tail are completely engulfed in flames.

species.name: Lumefur
species.flavor: The flame on its head as a child became a mane. This Nexomon is the perfect balance of power, speed, and... sharp claws!

species.name: Lumerei
species.flavor: Being armed with sharp fangs and claws makes it one of the most intimidating Nexomon one could hope not to encounter in battle.

species.name: Lunabelle
species.flavor: Its body is made of a very strong magnetic material. It uses its orbs to distract enemies.

species.name: Lurkennie
species.flavor: This Nexomon is infamous for playfully making its prey nervous until it is tired to fight back. It feeds on anxious thoughts.

species.name: Lurkost
species.flavor: A quiet crawling Nexomon that can turn transparent in order to mimic its environment. Nobody knows why it prefers to crawl, perhaps it enjoys simpy playing with its prey.

species.name: Luxa
species.flavor: King Omnicron's sixth child. While being relatively young, he is the largest primordial Tyrant. Luxa was a serpent that could smite humanity's greatest armies in the blink of an eye. Legends say that he disguised himself as a man named Zetta to wreak havoc from within cities.

species.name: Lycopain
species.flavor: Lycopain is well known among tamers for its bad temper. Experts point out that its face looks red due to its persisten bad mood causing constant blood flow and thus giving Lycopain a bright red tone.

species.name: Madamusa
species.flavor: Its psychic power is equivalent to the number of creatures on its heads. Each of these creatures have hypnotic abilities which makes it very difficult to approach.

species.name: Magnego
species.flavor: Magnego is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Magnipub
species.flavor: It is said that it can see into the future, but no one has ever confirmed this. It can the ring in its forehead to create squeaking sounds.

species.name: Magnymph
species.flavor: Magnymph is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Magonfly
species.flavor: Magonfly is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Magpillar
species.flavor: Magpillar is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Magpot
species.flavor: Magpot is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Malenostra
species.flavor: Know to be very territorial, it usually stays in the vicinity of the place it is guarding.

species.name: Malevodo
species.flavor: Its dance invokes unknown powers capable of controlling its opponents' movements.

species.name: Malfunctor
species.flavor: Malfunctor is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Malitress
species.flavor: It is said to be behind all the paranormal activity in most haunted places.

species.name: Mallark
species.flavor: It uses its twin hammer head to tackle and knock down its opponents. It also boasts good reflexes underwater and great water techniques.

species.name: Mallish
species.flavor: Its main defense mechanism is to smash oponents with its hammer-shaped head.

species.name: Mandrass
species.flavor: A seemingly weak and innocent Nexomon. And yet...

species.name: Mandrove
species.flavor: Mandrove is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mantoo
species.flavor: Its eyes grant it an impressive field of view. It also has razor sharp twin leaves on its tail.

species.name: Mantrass
species.flavor: A fighting expert with plenty of blades covering its body. Its attack speed is something to behold.

species.name: Manzan
species.flavor: Manzan is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mara
species.flavor: An adorable and intelligent Nexomon who knows how to use its charm in its favor during tamer battles. Loves to be pet.

species.name: Marasuma
species.flavor: Its mystic eyes are as deceiving as its appearance. Beneath all the foilage are more than just one thorn waiting to be usad as a weapon.

species.name: Maraudin
species.flavor: Maraudin is a very special Nexomon. Experts say that it evolved directly from a Hobyn (an extinct Nexomon). The similarities are evident, including its good nature and friendly behavior. Maraudins are known to share food with other Nexomon in need. No one knows where it gets so much food from though.

species.name: Masqat
species.flavor: This quiet Nexomon can easily blend into human society. It is a perfect companion, in sharp contrast to its younger form, Masquiti.

species.name: Masquiti
species.flavor: Often mistaken for a Ghost-type Nexomon, it is a Psychic-type with a somewhat obscure sense of humor.

species.name: Mazecter
species.flavor: The only physical part of this Nexomon is the iron maze on its tail, which it uses to lay on sleeping people or Nexomon to induce nightmares.

species.name: Mearn
species.flavor: A wild Nexomon that inhabits prairies and mountain ranges. It uses its entangled tails to read the wind while hunting.

species.name: Medlass
species.flavor: This cute Nexomon can be heard humming for most of the day. Some say it is to train its viperish living hair that seems to have a mind of its own.

species.name: Mellow
species.flavor: Mellow is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mermella
species.flavor: This Nexomon is a very rare sight, even for experienced sailors. Its hair becomes liquid when underwater, but outside is silky and brilliant. It propels itself at great speeds with its tail.

species.name: Metta
species.flavor: Metta is a -type Legendary Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Miglet
species.flavor: Miglet is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mimi
species.flavor: A quiet Nexomon. Master of psychic projection. Kids are often scared of it because of its appearance, but it's a very calm, kind Nexomon.

species.name: Mimorus
species.flavor: Its projection techniques provide a good defense, but it also takes mimicking to the next level, using its skills to distract and attack.

species.name: Minet
species.flavor: Its psychic abilities allow it to rewind memories, making some people believe they've gone back in time.

species.name: Minetor
species.flavor: Minetor is a walking power plant armed with two gigantic bulldozer-like pincers. Be careful when taming it.

species.name: Mistralion
species.flavor: Mistralion is a very rare wind Nexomon. Not many tamers have spotted one in the wild and the few that have are known to be tamers of the highest caliber. Finding a Mistralion is a challenge, but taming one is even more difficult.

species.name: Moga
species.flavor: A tamer's best friend. There are several friendly and loyal Nexomon, but none so much as Moga. For some reason, its always hungry. Do not feed it grapes!

species.name: Moink
species.flavor: Moink is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mojompu
species.flavor: Its reflexes are unmatched in the Nexomon world. It can jump very high and force in its legs to use as a fearsome weapon.

species.name: Molobomb
species.flavor: Molobomb is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Moltano
species.flavor: This massive magma cyclopes will show you the meaning of pain. Stay away from it by all means.

species.name: Monexus
species.flavor: Monexus is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Monkapow
species.flavor: It likes to eat all types of fruit. Even though its able to climb trees with ease, it prefers to shake the tree with its immense strength to force fruit to fall to the ground.

species.name: Monolix
species.flavor: Monolix is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Moonette
species.flavor: Moonette develops a second orb that floats around it. Its hair and skirt are made of pure magnetite filaments that interact with other minerals in its surroundings.

species.name: Moonica
species.flavor: Born from magnetic mineral deposits, a small rock orbits around it.

species.name: Moonline
species.flavor: As its name suggest, Moonline takes power from the moonlight. It has adapted several receivers, like its mushroom shaped head, for this purpose.

species.name: Moonsting
species.flavor: They feature amazing reflexes on their tails and a reinforced armor. This fire Nexomon is famous on all battlefields.

species.name: Moska
species.flavor: Moskas withstand the forces of the wind better than Larkitos, their complex eyes allow them to see any approaching object at slow motion.

species.name: Mound
species.flavor: It has superior senses and is an expert at using supersonic currents. It can hear predators well before they can locate it.

species.name: Moundrian
species.flavor: Moundrian is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mudlug
species.flavor: Mudlug is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mulcimer
species.flavor: The devious Tyrant of blaze who dwells in the volcanic region of New Ignitia. This despicable monster will scorch the land until he is acknowledged as the King of Monsters.

species.name: Mushamusha
species.flavor: Mushamusha is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Mustino
species.flavor: Mustino is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Muu
species.flavor: Only tamers searching for ghost Nexomon stay when they spot a Muu. Its surrounded by a heavy atmosphere and some say that darkness follows it.

species.name: Mystogen
species.flavor: The most intelligent of the greater drakes. It often travels from cave to cave in order to locate Tyrants. It probably helps that it can sense when a Tyrant is nearby using its psychic abilities.

species.name: Nakazuru
species.flavor: Its aerodynamics are above most flying Nexomon. You won't even see it fly by.

species.name: Namansi
species.flavor: King of the prairies, it has three tails which serves as both a distraction and to trap its opponents during battle.

species.name: Nara
species.flavor: The treacherous daughter of King Omnicron who machinated his downfall. Nara is the primordial Tyrant of Life, who teamed up with a human tamer millennia ago to defeat her own father. She is presumably immortal, but her whereabouts today are unknown.

species.name: Navrigal
species.flavor: Each Navrigal commands a flock of Croo. It is a skillful fighter and a superb strategist.

species.name: Neglente
species.flavor: Its power comes from its branches. Its root legs are very strong and give it incredible speed.

species.name: Nekgiri
species.flavor: Nekgiri is an all-around fighter that adds some flashy kicks to its previously learned punching style. It channels its inner energy to generate flames.

species.name: Nekomba
species.flavor: Nekomba is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Nekpanchi
species.flavor: Its puffy paws are weapons. With its instinct to fight, it can harden itself to bash its opponents.

species.name: Nightite
species.flavor: Nightite is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Nimburst
species.flavor: Nimburst is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ninstuff
species.flavor: It combines fighting styles in its soft movements. A master of timing and evasion, almost as if it was psychic.

species.name: Nivalis
species.flavor: A cowardly but stunningly cunning Tyrant. Nivalis does not tend to fight other Tyrants head on, and instead relies on careful schemes to grow in power, slowly creeping towards kinghood.

species.name: Nocgoyle
species.flavor: Nocgoyle is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Noki
species.flavor: An amphibious flying Nexomon with a heroic spirit. Its main characteristics are self confidence and loyalty.

species.name: Noocidal
species.flavor: Noocidal uses all its limbs to perform advanced battle techniques. Thus, it normally has its head attached to its body, unlike Heddecas.

species.name: Nutchok
species.flavor: Nutchok is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Obelink
species.flavor: Obelink is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Octollect
species.flavor: The supreme mind of the ocean. Octollects have developed their psychic powers to the point where they can lure their lunch to them.

species.name: Odiborg
species.flavor: Odiborgs have complex circuitry and mechanics within their bodies. Each of their three sensors or eyes is independent of each other.

species.name: Ogoon
species.flavor: A steed of unparalleled speed, and Ziegler's quickest warrior. Ogoon has patrolled the Netherworld of millenia, keeping an eye on any souls attempting to escape his master's grasp.

species.name: Omecharge
species.flavor: A triple minded Nexomon who likes to chat with itself. Unfortunately, its three inseparable heads don't often agree. Watch out when they synchronize!

species.name: Omentic
species.flavor: A cloud-like Electric-type Nexomon capable of separating its body cells to attract energy or avoid damage.

species.name: Omepark
species.flavor: Its body is charged with so much pure energy that it glows. It can connect to power sources with its tail to powering up.

species.name: Omnicron
species.flavor: Omnicron is a -type Legendary Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Omnisun
species.flavor: King Omnicron's true heir/heiress and Nara's own child. A supreme Tyrant who is destinied to rule every Nexomon in the world and shape its very future, for better or for worse. What will you do with such power, (Player's Name)?

species.name: Onin
species.flavor: This joyful plant Nexomon has a great sense of friendship and loyalty, and an unfortunate smell that not everybody likes.

species.name: Onsloceros
species.flavor: Onsloceros is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Oregoon
species.flavor: A true mountain dragon. No one knows how a heavy like this can fly at great altitudes with ease. Its skin and wings are rock-hard.

species.name: Oren
species.flavor: Its mineral crest resembles a steep rocky mountain where it usually resides. It feeds on all sorts of minerals.

species.name: Orgot
species.flavor: Orgot is the only mid-stage dragon Nexomon that can fly. It's often seen flying through clouds. It is the descendant of a mountain dragon.

species.name: Orologikus
species.flavor: This Nexomon is in a totally different league than Minets. Studies show it can slow down or accelerate time for its surroundings.

species.name: Ostridge
species.flavor: Ostridge is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ostrolt
species.flavor: This Nexomon is among the fastest of ground based Nexomon. Some say it's as fast as lightning and its chirp is so loud that it sounds like thunder as it reaches top speed.

species.name: Outgrov
species.flavor: It enjoys sunlight above anything else and dislikes the chill of winter.

species.name: Owlie
species.flavor: Owlie is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Palsae
species.flavor: Palsae boasts more variation in color than Sae, but its colors are not only for show. It uses them to hide among flowers from which it collects its beloved nutrients.

species.name: Pandicub
species.flavor: Pandicub is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Parchidna
species.flavor: Its superb mobility on almost any terrain, strong legs, and large size makes it a terrifyingly good hunter.

species.name: Parchyon
species.flavor: Parchyon is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Parrpy
species.flavor: Parrpy is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Paupo
species.flavor: This Nexomon has a very mysterious origin. It can be seen outside of towns disguised as a human. No one knows its expression is so forlorn.

species.name: Pebglem
species.flavor: Pebglem are very quiet Nexomon that can project light from the gem fin in their head. They can be noisy when happy though.

species.name: Peltry
species.flavor: Don't upset this Nexomon! The awful smell of its tears causes everybody in the surrounding area to start crying too.

species.name: Pentapus
species.flavor: Pentapus is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Perchara
species.flavor: Perchara is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Perleo
species.flavor: Perleo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Petram
species.flavor: A formidable golem that has been waging war against the Laterians for years. Petram is seemingly indestructible and may very well become the next King of Monsters someday simply by enduring any attack without a scratch.

species.name: Petril
species.flavor: Petril is a -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Phantra
species.flavor: This bat-like specter prefers nights with full moons to scare those who dare to enter its territory. It feeds on all sorts of emotions, allowing it to control its prey's mind.

species.name: Pharamoth
species.flavor: Pharamoth is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Pincer
species.flavor: Pincer is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Pincertron
species.flavor: Pincertron is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Pira
species.flavor: Pira is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Platyfoo
species.flavor: Platyfoo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ploriol
species.flavor: A small flying Nexomon with delicate but sharp-edged wings that can summon the power of the forest. It uses its tail as a pummeling weapon against opponents.

species.name: Pluvean
species.flavor: Perhaps the most perplexing of the Abyssal Tyrants. Pluvean emerged from the waters near Palmaya, and only waited for the Guild to eventually hunt it down, as if it desired its own demise.

species.name: Polenblom
species.flavor: Polenblom is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Polerina
species.flavor: Polerina is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Pompatiel
species.flavor: Pompatiel is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Pongo
species.flavor: This Nexomon lives in a herd on the slopes of steep mountains. Its fire wool helps keep it warm during blisteringly cold winters.

species.name: Ponic
species.flavor: It hops around on a haunted toy. No one knows its origin.

species.name: Ponirius
species.flavor: Ponirius is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Pont
species.flavor: Should you venture into a cave, watch out for moving stalactites! This Nexomon is known to be aggressive and packs a punch.

species.name: Porapora
species.flavor: Porapora is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Porklet
species.flavor: This little Nexomon makes use of its fat to power its fire attacks.

species.name: Potpot
species.flavor: Widely regarded as a friendly Nexomon that enjoys the companionship of humans.

species.name: Poyal
species.flavor: An adorable Nexomon dressed as a sailor. Always ready for action and extremely loyal.

species.name: Prankrow
species.flavor: When wandering through lonely locales, make sure to differentiate real scarecrows from this Nexomon. Its favorite prank is named "scare and chase".

species.name: Prismazor
species.flavor: Prismazor is a wildly popular plant Nexomon in the Nexomon community and even won a popularity contest among tamers. It not only looks impressive but also battles with incredible skill. This Nexomon is an all-rounder, and it is proven to be the go-to Nexomon for most experienced tamers.

species.name: Protovados
species.flavor: Amelie's perfect creation. An artificial Tyrant sworn to protect mankind by exterminating other Tyrants once and for all. Vados is exceedingly intelligent, rational, and strong. There is no doubt that he can lead humanity to a new age of prosperity if he so desires.

species.name: Puggard
species.flavor: This trusty Nexomon is known to take too many risks during battle, making it a little unreliable.

species.name: Quarauga
species.flavor: Quarauga's flowers float around and protect it from harm. It can perform various attacks using any of its flowers.

species.name: Quarmor
species.flavor: Its body shape allows it to spin like a giant drill.

species.name: Raamu
species.flavor: Raamu is a fearless Nexomon. It never runs from a battle, and it is constantly looking for a challenge to hone its skills. Sadly, not many Nexomon can offer Raamu a challenge, making them very isolated from other Nexomon.

species.name: Rafodillo
species.flavor: Rafodillo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Raksuma
species.flavor: Tall and elegant, considered the guardian of the forest and protector of life. It doesn't enjoy fighting other Nexomon and tends to be overprotective of others.

species.name: Rapi
species.flavor: This charming Nexomon loves to sunbathe while leaning on its powerful tail, which it also uses to crack open nuts.

species.name: Rapilux
species.flavor: Elegant and flamboyant - exactly the cover it needs to hide its resourceful abilities.

species.name: Rapnux
species.flavor: An eternal wanderer and master of battle. Its reflexes far surpass those of any warrior and it can move silently.

species.name: Rappub
species.flavor: A very domesticated Nexomon, it is sociable and aware of its own combat capabilities. Not so tameable when it grows up, however.

species.name: Ratapon
species.flavor: Ratapon is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ratatusk
species.flavor: Ratatusk is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Reeferus
species.flavor: An extremely fast underwater Nexomon. Most of its attacks benefit from its slippery leafshaped fins and from the air pressure generated from micro-bubbles in its skin.

species.name: Replicanti
species.flavor: Replicanti is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Reptomotor
species.flavor: A fast Nexomon with immense agility and flashy attacks. It can to conceal its presence, but rarely uses it as it is confident in its own strength.

species.name: Resonect
species.flavor: Resonect is a high voltage Nexomon. Beware of scaring a Resonect as its primary defese is to electrocute anyone who poes a threat to them. That being said, Resonect gets scared quite easily.

species.name: Resonic
species.flavor: Resonic has several electrical amplifiers throughout its body, especially on its wings, which act like giant lightning rods.

species.name: Ribombo
species.flavor: It doesn't pay too much attention to anything that could stress it out and lives a tranquil life absorbed in its own dreams.

species.name: Ripha
species.flavor: It takes a keen eye to spot one of these Nexomon. It's the dark ghost of the Nexomon world.

species.name: Robatt
species.flavor: Robatt is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Roclas
species.flavor: It is ridiculously strong and able to lift and carry big mineral boulders that it devours during a battle for a boost.

species.name: Rocstrich
species.flavor: Rocstrich is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Roohopu
species.flavor: Roohopu is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Rooskipa
species.flavor: Rooskipa is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Rotramus
species.flavor: Rotramus was an Abyssal Tyrant that would actively avoid any conflict and focus on sleeping deep in the woods, making his pressence as scarce as possible. Nevertheless, paranoia drove the Guild to hunt him down anyway.

species.name: Rubby
species.flavor: Don't leave your belongings unattended around this fluffy Nexomon. It checks every pocket it can for something to steal.

species.name: Runk
species.flavor: A seasoned burglar. When caught, it never hesitates to show its street fighting skills.

species.name: Rust
species.flavor: It uses its steel helmet for both offense and defense.

species.name: Rustu
species.flavor: Its armor can resist most attacks while minimizing damage taken.

species.name: Rustung
species.flavor: A versatile fighter, it relies on its armor's durability and superior physical strength.

species.name: Sae
species.flavor: It enjoys colorful objects and loves all varieties of sweet food.

species.name: Sakka
species.flavor: Sakkas can fly higher and faster than Moskas, their annoying buzzing is so sharp that it can break thin glass.

species.name: Sandillo
species.flavor: Small, cute and a little clumsy. This Nexomon is covered in a hard shell that allows it to roll around deserts.

species.name: Satray
species.flavor: Satray is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Saxia
species.flavor: Saxia is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Scabrillo
species.flavor: Scabrillo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Scailla
species.flavor: Its tail can generate light in deep waters. Its whiskers and tongue are said to be acidic and its arms are covered with hard scales.

species.name: Scalder
species.flavor: It uses its long tongue to help stabilize underwater, then benefits from a super-aerodynamic tail to increase the speed of its moves.

species.name: Scaratic
species.flavor: It charges electricity from the objects it locates on the ground.

species.name: Scizarina
species.flavor: Scizarina is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Scooptor
species.flavor: Its mechanical appearance and the sheer force of its pincers makes this Nexomon a formidable and intimidating opponent.

species.name: Scurrel
species.flavor: Scurrel is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Seadian
species.flavor: Seadian is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Seaguard
species.flavor: Seaguard is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Seaphon
species.flavor: Seaphon is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Seatail
species.flavor: Seatail is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Seatusk
species.flavor: Seatusk is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Sectoc
species.flavor: Ever feel like time moves too slow or too fast? Perhaps this Nexomon was playing tricks on you nearby.

species.name: Seedko
species.flavor: A light Nexomon capable of soaring in the wind and propelling itself using the two blade leaves on its head. It changes direction using the weights on its lower body.

species.name: Seedkorsky
species.flavor: A dynamic Nexomon whose movements resemble a spinning dance in the air. It has total control of its bodies during flight.

species.name: Seedread
species.flavor: Seedread is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Senshizuru
species.flavor: An imposing silhouette soars the skies. One of the largest and strongest Nexomon, its wings can generate winds up to 120 MPH.

species.name: Seraforona
species.flavor: Seraforona is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Serala
species.flavor: Serala is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Shardberg
species.flavor: It can cause avalanches and blizzards with the horn on its forehead, making it difficult to spot amongst all the heavy snowdrift.

species.name: Shardice
species.flavor: This Nexomon enjoys exploring and can create or melt ice at will. It often tests its strength by headbutting others.

species.name: Shardrillion
species.flavor: It skillfully digs tunnels, looking for its favorite crystals to eat. Although its incredible heavy, it makes only a soft dragging sound when moving.

species.name: Shardrine
species.flavor: This elegant and swift Nexomon is made from the toughest natural metals. Despite its weight, it manages to move without making any noise.

species.name: Sharnoll
species.flavor: Sharnoll is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Shashock
species.flavor: Shashock is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Sheral
species.flavor: Sheral is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Shereef
species.flavor: Shereef is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Shermit
species.flavor: Shermit is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Shloom
species.flavor: It benefits from the sun's power. The colorful flower on its shell is a warning to enemies.

species.name: Shrepian
species.flavor: Shrepian is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Shromboff
species.flavor: A mean looking Nexomon usually found in the middle of the forest. It means double trouble because of its double heads.

species.name: Shrombrela
species.flavor: The more spores, the more energy. It blooms an extra head to collect more humidity from the air.

species.name: Shromporo
species.flavor: You might venture through the forest without even noticing this Nexomon. It prefers dark corners in a thick foliage where it can grow and feed.

species.name: Shrubbit
species.flavor: Shrubbit is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Siki
species.flavor: Despite its size, this Nexomon is very selfconfident and can be seen hiding under dry leaves or absorbing sunlight out int he wild. It feeds on fruit and fresh leaves.

species.name: Sikihob
species.flavor: Sikihobs uses its staff as a weapon and is known for mastering martial techniques from the far east.

species.name: Sikipha
