species.flavor: Beware of its plant techniques! This Nexomon combines nature with physical attacks to make it very difficult to read during battle.

species.name: Silkmaid
species.flavor: Silkmaid is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Silkpha
species.flavor: Silkpha is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Singlette
species.flavor: It releases the sweetest fragrance to attract its soulmate, Singletti.

species.name: Singletti
species.flavor: A special type of Nexomon that is always looking for its soulmate, Singlette.

species.name: Sirnymfa
species.flavor: Known as the protector of the sea, the few sailors that have seen this Nexomon became mute for weeks because of its beauty and magical powers.

species.name: Skerdi
species.flavor: A basic spectral form yet to be studied. Their grumpy face does not match their kind and gentle actions.

species.name: Skoi
species.flavor: Skoi is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Skounquet
species.flavor: The once adorable paws of a Skunqeau transformed into pummeling hammers with sharp nails.

species.name: Skunqeau
species.flavor: A friendly and adorable Nexomon, that is always looking to socialize. It can control its smell better than Skunqute.

species.name: Skunqute
species.flavor: Its adorable appearance belies its foul smell, which is its main defense against opponents.

species.name: Sliffery
species.flavor: Sliffery is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Slithera
species.flavor: Slithera is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Smanic
species.flavor: A small Nexomon that gathers electrical charge from the particles in humid air.

species.name: Snaibble
species.flavor: A bubble blowing Nexomon which stores water in its very hard shell. They eye-like part of its shell is for camouflage purposes.

species.name: Snaiflow
species.flavor: It walks on two feet and can run very fast, leaving a slime trail in its wake that can be either very sticky or very slippery.

species.name: Snaijet
species.flavor: Its shell boasts two horns on an already mean-looking shell, but it really didn't need it to scare its opponents anymore, did it? Its sharp claws can be used to dig traps.

species.name: Snush
species.flavor: Because of its slow nature, it relies on paralyzing opponents with sleeping spores to defend itself.

species.name: Solus
species.flavor: The so-called “Tyrant of Light” is a popular bedtime story of a loving and forgiving Tyrant who seeks to protect humans and Nexomon alike. Of course, there is no such thing as a good Tyrant – but every legend has some truth to it.

species.name: Sonicoco
species.flavor: Sonicoco is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Soniqo
species.flavor: Its large ears provide two functions: navigation and absorption of electric particles in the air.

species.name: Sorvian
species.flavor: While its speed is commendable, its greatest perk is its intuition, which allows it to move across the skies as if predicting where danger will strike next.

species.name: Sounse
species.flavor: A very sensitive Nexomon with the ability to hear from very long distances away. Its special connection with the wind makes it an excellent weather forecaster.

species.name: Spectrice
species.flavor: Spectrice is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Spektar
species.flavor: A ghostly manifestation of ancient Nexomon. It channels ancient energies to gather tremendous power.

species.name: Spikarm
species.flavor: Once a Spikus is able to stand on two feet, it learns how to shoot its thorns. They also develop great admiration for their newly acquired arms.

species.name: Spikus
species.flavor: A merry but un-huggable Nexomon who likes to jump and uses its spikes during battle and for protection against predators.

species.name: Spina
species.flavor: Spina is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Spink
species.flavor: Spink is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Sprouti
species.flavor: Sprouti is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Sprunk
species.flavor: Sprunk is a -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Spurk
species.flavor: Spurk is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Stalagca
species.flavor: This spiky Nexomon benefits from all the minerals carried by underground rivers, which adds an extra layer of hardness to its armor.

species.name: Stalkee
species.flavor: A master of disguise with lightning-quick reflexes. Its shears through opponents with its claws in the blink of an eye.

species.name: Starckal
species.flavor: It can power-up any Psychic-type move with the ring on its hand and project powerful beams with its forehead ring. It is particularly skilled at creating multiple illusions.

species.name: Steamous
species.flavor: Steamous is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Stelmo
species.flavor: Stelmo is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Stinger
species.flavor: This fire Nexomon likes to hide under sand or heavy rocks. Usually short tempered, it really like quiet places, so noises can easily make them angry. Its design was directly taken from the predecessor game Micromon.

species.name: Stoaic
species.flavor: Stoaic is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Stoogu
species.flavor: Stoogu is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Streamoad
species.flavor: It uses its inseparable stick to slap at opponents. Thanks to its palette shaped tail, it can swim in any body of water at ridiculous speeds.

species.name: Streamog
species.flavor: This Nexomon can jump up to 15 times its own height. Its eyes allow it to see in murky waters while its crown-like fin serves as camouflage.

species.name: Streamole
species.flavor: A small and seemingly fragile Nexomon, it relies on its evasiveness and a slippery body to use its water attacks from a safe location.

species.name: Suavian
species.flavor: Suavian is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Sulphlo
species.flavor: When reaching adulthood, Kolphurs fulfill their dreams and transform in a small volcano. Hot bubbles of Sulphur can be seen moving throughout its boiling eye.

species.name: Sunknight
species.flavor: This fire Nexomon is not only heavily armored, but also has fire moving along its tail, making it very difficult to approach.

species.name: Sunnos
species.flavor: A powerful and sometimes malicious psychic Nexomon, that people often confuse with Ghost-type. The ring on its forehead creates very powerful illusions.

species.name: Swactrum
species.flavor: Its bird-like form is perfect for controlling the shadows. It flies above its opponents, disappearing and reappearing in advantageous places.

species.name: Swamplow
species.flavor: The viscous cover of its shell traps all kind of objects, such as branches, moss, sludge, and curious travelers who dare to touch.

species.name: Sylphi
species.flavor: Sylphi is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Taffaca
species.flavor: Taffaca is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Taipluff
species.flavor: An apprentices of inner martial arts. It seeks to learn the ways of softness and are already masters of fluffiness.

species.name: Tantrunt
species.flavor: It doesn't like to be close to tamers, which makes it even more angry than it appears to be. It benefits from this anger to power its inner flame.

species.name: Tarragon
species.flavor: Colloquially known as the terror of the skies. A true descendant of the dragons. Its strength, defense, and resistance are overwhelming, requiring a master tamer to capture it.

species.name: Tempestra
species.flavor: Tempestra is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tephragon
species.flavor: In the past, Tephragon excelled at tracking other Nexomon, making it a favorite among tamers. Rumor has it that the Guild took interest in this ability, and used Tephragon as a template to engineer today's dragons.

species.name: Terbite
species.flavor: Terbite is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Teslad
species.flavor: The smartest of all Nexomon, it knows practically everything about electricity. You can't allow yourself to make a mistake against it.

species.name: Tesling
species.flavor: A curious and intelligent Nexomon. What it lacks in strength it compensates with intelligence and proficiency in electric skills.

species.name: Thermofly
species.flavor: Thermofly is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Thornox
species.flavor: Thornox can throw projectile spikes from its knees and shoulders, combined with cool dance moves and extreme accuracy.

species.name: Thrammer
species.flavor: This Nexomon is full of surprises. Every part of its body is a potential weapon.

species.name: Thrano
species.flavor: Thrano is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tikala
species.flavor: Tyrant may not be the most appropriate term to describ Tikala, for he actively avoids conflict and seems to lack any interest in becoming the King of Monsters. He spends most of his time in hiding, which is fine by the Guild and other Tyrants alike.

species.name: Tiki
species.flavor: It can be found in dark ruins, caves, and abandoned villages. It usually stays away from towns, since it's walking fire-hazard.

species.name: Tiliamber
species.flavor: A hot-blooded Nexomon whose smoke-like whiskers can produce smoke screens. It has immense strength in its arms.

species.name: Tinito
species.flavor: Tinito is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tirtrauma
species.flavor: Tirtrauma is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Titan
species.flavor: Titan was created by Ziegler and serves as a warden in the Netherworld. His main role is guarding the gateway between the mortal world and Ziegler’s domain.

species.name: Toka
species.flavor: Toka is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tomathorn
species.flavor: Tomathorn is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tornadyr
species.flavor: Tornadyr is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Torrex
species.flavor: Torrex enjoys living in turbulent waters. This fact makes them incredible versatile water Nexomon and are almost unmatched in the water. Their fins are colorful and used for intimidation but are also as sharp as any weapon.

species.name: Toxipore
species.flavor: Toxipore is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Trampole
species.flavor: Trampole is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Trebly
species.flavor: Always eager to prove the durability of its horns, it loves nothing more than a simple headbutting competition.

species.name: Treclay
species.flavor: A great hunter despite its small hands. It has even been witnessed digging mountain passes just by smashing its head against rock.

species.name: Treemi
species.flavor: Treemi is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tresaur
species.flavor: Abnormally resistant to physical attacks, it can make its tails as soft as mud or as hard as steel on a whim.

species.name: Trimion
species.flavor: Trimion is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Trondle
species.flavor: Trondle has a firm grip, and this makes them highly competent climbers. It is also said that once Trondle grabs you, there is almost no way to escape. Trondle can only be distracted by particular foods, and only then will it let go of you.

species.name: Tropi
species.flavor: Tropi is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tropite
species.flavor: Tropite is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tryflap
species.flavor: Tryflap is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tundri
species.flavor: Tundri is a small merry Nexomon that enjoys creating big snowflakes with several different shapes and patterns.

species.name: Tundrox
species.flavor: It creates an inaudible sound that can change the direction of a storm. It enjoys hiding under snow to surprise both its prey and its companions.

species.name: Turbinha
species.flavor: Turbinha is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tuskant
species.flavor: A stomping water Nexomon. It features twin water cannons in each arm.

species.name: Twillow
species.flavor: Twillow is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tycroc
species.flavor: Tycroc is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Tyrake
species.flavor: Unlike most Greater Drakes, Tyrake has chosen to dwell near its birthplace: the skyward country of Drake Isles. While unquestionably strong, Tyrake does not often confront Tyrants, for they are not foolish enough to invade the home turf of the dragons themselves.

species.name: Tyregg
species.flavor: Tyregg is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vados
species.flavor: Amelie’s unbeatable aberration at its full power. All around the world, Tyrants cower in fear upon Vados’s wake. This is Amelie’s ultimate gift to mankind.

species.name: Vainok
species.flavor: With its water attacks and long tail, its opponents rarely manage to escape its assault. Extremely hard to find and even more difficult to catch.

species.name: Vanarosta
species.flavor: Vanarosta is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vaprat
species.flavor: Vaprats are very popular among fire specialists tamers. They are extremely friendly to humans in general. Vaprat has powerful fire skills and is very easy to tame. However, it takes a while for them to work with other Nexomon as a team.

species.name: Varawirl
species.flavor: It uses its double tail to form whirlpools. Most of its attacks have a spinning effect that ups its potency.

species.name: Velokitti
species.flavor: Velokitti is an -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Venefelis
species.flavor: The first recorded Abyssal Tyrant, who awakened shortly after King Omnicron’s downfall. Venefelis attacked the Immortal Citadel, before finally being sealed away in the woods by a hero.

species.name: Venemona
species.flavor: Venemona is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Venowar
species.flavor: Venemona is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ventofawn
species.flavor: Ventofawn is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Ventra
species.flavor: The second daughter of King Omnicron. As the primordial winged Tyrant of the Tempest, she was the very reason humans feared to look up at the sky. She once took the form of a woman called Nadine, but her disguise could barely hold her malevolent aura.

species.name: Virox
species.flavor: This Nexomon can come in many sizes. Its passive look and floating movement are compensated with great psychic power.

species.name: Vivizard
species.flavor: Vivizard is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vodo
species.flavor: It enjoys playing pranks by linking its mind and body with unwary tamers.

species.name: Volcel
species.flavor: Volcel was an Abyssal Tyrant that excelled at scouting and locating other living beings, making him quite difficult to chase as he’d always know when enemies were approaching.

species.name: Volnamic
species.flavor: Its large ears allow for better aerodynamics, while its mid-size wings enable soft landings at speed. Its scales provide extra protection during combat.

species.name: Volpressor
species.flavor: This Nexomon is an electrical power emitter and is not just incredibly smart but can also manipulate electricity at will with any part of its body.

species.name: Volt
species.flavor: Its tail, forehead, chest, and neck are covered with a thin layer of scales for protection and isolation. Its bite is as strong as its bark.

species.name: Volta
species.flavor: The greater drake of lightning has no fixed location and adventurers can encoutner him when they least expect it. Volta's sporadic behavior has troubled Tyrants for as long as they can remember.

species.name: Voltaic
species.flavor: It can fly at considerable high altitudes. Its wings, horns, and chest remain as evidence of its dragon legacy. Oh, and it also has the power to summon lightning.

species.name: Voltosfere
species.flavor: Voltosfere is a rare electric Nexomon that boasts one of the highest electric outputs out there for any Nexomon. Experts say that at its peak, it is powerful enough to power an entire village by itself.

species.name: Vorapest
species.flavor: Vorapest is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vozette
species.flavor: Vozette is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vulazy
species.flavor: Vulazy is a -type Starter Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vulpep
species.flavor: Vulpep is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Vultic
species.flavor: Vultic is an -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1 .

species.name: Wadgon
species.flavor: This feathered, viper-like drake produces a stunning humming sound from its rattling tail scales. The crown on its head can reflect light like a mirror.

species.name: Wadtail
species.flavor: This elegant Nexomon has legs strong enough to support its body but prefers to hop or levitate using its wings.

species.name: Walnormous
species.flavor: Walnormous is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Wargoyle
species.flavor: A lonely Nexomon. Even after earning its trust, a tamer must go through further tests to be truly worthy of leading it in battle.

species.name: Waser
species.flavor: A cautious, very defensive Nexomon. Tamers requires a great deal of patience to earn its trust, and even more for its friendship.

species.name: Weabride
species.flavor: Weabride is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Weavolt
species.flavor: Weavolt, regardless of its size, is highly agile and excels in both electric and melee attacks. A Weavolt is one of the few Nexomon to be seen training without a tamer to get stronger as they tend to be very competitive.

species.name: Wiselie
species.flavor: Wiselie is a night creature, and it really hates bright lights and often avoids being seen in broad daylight. Their special feathers make their movements extremely silent. Opponents rarely get a chance to see what hit them.

species.name: Woozy
species.flavor: A fluffy Nexomon that resides on high plains. Its wool allows it to store lots of static power.

species.name: Worb
species.flavor: A sneaky Nexomon with poor eyesight. The shiny orb on its backs is not its abdomen, but a jewel that helps crystalize its enemies.

species.name: Wysil
species.flavor: Even though it can't truly fly, it can remain a few feet off the ground for long periods. Its super strong, with great defense and resistance because of its dragon scales.

species.name: Wyverne
species.flavor: The heaviest of the greater drakes can be seen hunting Tyrants around the Outlands near Parum. Citizens have grown used to this sight, and adventurers use this opportunity to explore without fear of Tyrants.

species.name: Xotor
species.flavor: Xotors are a proof of Chibbits natural origin, their hard crystal dome protects their biological core, which acts as both a brain and a heart.

species.name: Yarnesty
species.flavor: A balanced and precise hunter. It can detect and manipulate wind streams from any direction and use them to defend or attack in battle.

species.name: Yomnom
species.flavor: Its symbiotic relationship with sweetness translates into raw power. While a little heavy, it is extremely alert because of all the sugar in its body.

species.name: Yummo
species.flavor: Yummo obtains its powers from a sugar rush. It loves all kinds of sweets, especially those with chocolate.

species.name: Zappnic
species.flavor: Zappnics are the highest class in the electric hive. Their stings store enough electric charge to stun anyone.

species.name: Zasp
species.flavor: Zasps are faster and have more complex roles in the colony than Zumbles. They emit electro-magnetic fields to disorient predators from the hive.

species.name: Ziegler
species.flavor: The King of the Netherworld who oversees the Afterlife. A creature even more ancient than Omnicron himself, and thus, perhaps, not even a Nexomon at all. Not much is known about this powerful being, which may be for the best.

species.name: Zombyant
species.flavor: Zombyant is a -type Nexomon introduced in Nexomon 1.

species.name: Zumble
species.flavor: Zumbles navigate and communicate with their hive through their two antennas, which channel positive and negative electric charges respectively.
